Clean and Format JSON Data Online

Developers often need to inspect API output, fix malformed JSON, or convert table data. This workflow groups the data tools in one place.

Recommended workflow

  1. Paste JSON into JSON Formatter to validate it.
  2. Use JSON Minifier when sending compact data.
  3. Convert CSV to JSON when moving spreadsheet data into an app.
  4. Convert JSON to CSV when preparing spreadsheet exports.
  5. Use Base64 or URL tools only when encoding is required.

Tools used in this workflow

  • JSON Formatter — Format, beautify, and validate JSON online with exact error messages, indentation control, copy, and download options.
  • JSON Validator — Validate JSON online and find parsing errors quickly. Works locally in your browser.
  • JSON Minifier — Minify JSON online to remove whitespace and reduce file size while keeping valid JSON structure.
  • CSV to JSON Converter — Convert CSV data to JSON online with header-row detection and clean formatted output.
  • JSON to CSV Converter — Convert JSON arrays to CSV online for spreadsheets, reports, and data cleanup.
  • Base64 Encoder Decoder — Encode text to Base64 or decode Base64 back to text directly in your browser.
  • URL Encoder Decoder — Encode or decode URLs and query strings online using browser-safe URL encoding.

Why this workflow works

It follows a safe order: fix dimensions and format first, then optimize size, then verify the final output. This prevents quality loss and reduces repeated uploads.

Frequently asked questions

Is my data uploaded?

These developer tools run locally in your browser.

Why is my JSON invalid?

Common causes include trailing commas, unquoted keys, and single quotes.
